stories.title: Weekend weather: warm Saturday then Sunday rain for Flintshire
stories.summary: Flintshire is set for a warm, dry Saturday before rain arrives on Sunday, bringing a brief change after weeks of dry weather. The Met Office forecast for Flintshire shows a high of 24C on Saturday, with the morning dry and the chance of rain rising to 30% from mid-afternoon. Temperatures are expected to reach 23C

stories.summary: A specialist firefighting helicopter has arrived at the Rhinogydd wildfire, which has been burning for more than a week in the mountains near Harlech. stories.title: School swimming lessons programme to begin rolling out across Wales this autumn
stories.summary: Primary school pupils in Wales will get access to swimming and water safety lessons under a new national programme starting this autumn. stories.title: Flintshire: 44-tonne lorry recorded at 85mph during police speed checks on A55
stories.summary: A 44-tonne articulated lorry was recorded travelling at 85mph on the A55 at Broughton during police speed checks on Thursday afternoon. stories.title: Manchester Airport drop-off now second priciest in UK per minute, RAC finds
stories.summary: Dropping someone off at Manchester Airport now works out at £1.10 a minute, making it the second most expensive airport in the UK on a per-minute basis, according to new RAC analysis.
